text:
sylvia: Quick heads-up  change window in 10m. Deploying ranking-service v5.0.2. Flip FF `ff_split_ranking_v2` in split mode: 15% -> 45% -> 100%. We'll pin model routing to prod-v3.1 for 45m. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v5.0.2. Any immediate concerns?

deploy-bot: Scheduled: 2024-06-21T10:00:00PT. Canary=6. Ramp plan: 15% @t+3m, 45% @t+11m, 100% @t+25m. Auto-pause on p99>220ms for 4m OR 5xx>0.5% for 3m OR cache_hit drop >6% for 5m.

omar: I'll watch SLOs and top-user latency. Add downstream qps delta >12% as a pause condition.

kelly: Ops note: please include rollback one-liner in thread and confirm who can run it.

deploy-bot: Rollback snippet (operator):
```
redwoodctl ff set ff_split_ranking_v2 0 --reason "rollback: safety gate"
redwoodctl routing pin model prod-v3.1 --duration 45m
```

oncall-bot: Oncall rotation: infra-team is primary. Pager duty policy linked PD-RANKING-RAMP.

sylvia: Runbook updated: pause -> gather top10 traces -> notify #incidents -> decision within 12m. Also log token-cost estimate change in release doc.

deploy-bot: Canary stable at 15% @t+5m. Moving to 45%.

omar: small p95 wiggle at t+9m but transient. No pause.

deploy-bot: Reached 45% @t+12m. Holding 13m before final step.

kelly: infra healthy, cache stable. Proceed when green for 8m.

deploy-bot: Reached 100% @t+26m. Full rollout complete. Model routing pinned until +45m. Final note: if any anomalies, reopen and tag infra-team.
